title: Auto click PRO
script:
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "Auto click PRO"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    handle = handle or frame

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart
    local startPos
    local activeInput

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            activeInput = input

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    activeInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    local function updatePosition(input)
        if not dragging then return end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)

    UIS.TouchMoved:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and activeInput == input then
            updatePosition(input)
        end
    end)
end

-- BARRA PRINCIPAL
local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
Bar.Name = "Bar"
Bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 150)
Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0.5, -75)
Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Bar.Active = true
Bar.Parent = ScreenGui

-- TÍTULO ÚNICO
local Title = Instance.new("TextButton")
Title.Name = "Title"
Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 24)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -24)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
Title.BorderSizePixel = 0
Title.Text = ""
Title.AutoButtonColor = false
Title.Active = true
Title.Parent = Bar

-- TEXTO ÚNICO, SEM SEPARAR LABEL E PRO
local TitleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleText.Name = "TitleText"
TitleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, 0)
TitleText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
TitleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleText.RichText = true
TitleText.Text = '<font color="#FFFFFF">Auto click </font><font color="#D000FF">PRO</font>'
TitleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleText.TextSize = 11
TitleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
TitleText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
TitleText.TextScaled = false
TitleText.Parent = Title

-- BRILHO EM TODAS AS PALAVRAS
task.spawn(function()
    while TitleText.Parent do
        local a = TweenService:Create(
            TitleText,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),
            {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 140, 255)}
        )
        a:Play()
        a.Completed:Wait()

        if not TitleText.Parent then break end

        local b = TweenService:Create(
            TitleText,
            TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),
            {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}
        )
        b:Play()
        b.Completed:Wait()
    end
end)

makeDraggable(Bar, Title)

-- CORES DOS BOTÕES
local blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 255)
local green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
local red = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)

local running = false
local targets = {}
local clickDelay = 0.04

-- BOTÃO LIGAR/DESLIGAR
local BtnToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnToggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
BtnToggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
BtnToggle.BackgroundColor3 = blue
BtnToggle.Text = "⏯"
BtnToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
BtnToggle.Parent = Bar

-- BOTÃO ADICIONAR QUADRADO
local BtnAdd = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnAdd.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
BtnAdd.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
BtnAdd.BackgroundColor3 = green
BtnAdd.Text = "+"
BtnAdd.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
BtnAdd.Parent = Bar

-- BOTÃO LIMPAR
local BtnClear = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnClear.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
BtnClear.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 100)
BtnClear.BackgroundColor3 = red
BtnClear.Text = "X"
BtnClear.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
BtnClear.Parent = Bar

-- CLIQUE AUTOMÁTICO
local function clickAt(pos)
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(
        pos.X, pos.Y, 0, true, game, 0
    )
    VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(
        pos.X, pos.Y, 0, false, game, 0
    )
end

task.spawn(function()
    while ScreenGui.Parent do
        if running then
            for _, square in ipairs(targets) do
                if not running then break end

                if square.Parent then
                    clickAt(Vector2.new(
                        square.AbsolutePosition.X + square.AbsoluteSize.X / 2,
                        square.AbsolutePosition.Y + square.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
                    ))
                    task.wait(clickDelay)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)

BtnToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    running = not running

    for _, square in ipairs(targets) do
        square.Active = not running
    end
end)

BtnAdd.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local square = Instance.new("Frame")
    square.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
    square.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.5, -20)
    square.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    square.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    square.Active = true
    square.Parent = ScreenGui

    makeDraggable(square)
    table.insert(targets, square)
end)

BtnClear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, square in ipairs(targets) do
        square:Destroy()
    end
    targets = {}
end)

-- BRILHO NEON PULSANTE
task.spawn(function()
    while TitleText.Parent do
        TitleText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
        TitleText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        TitleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

        task.wait(0.3)

        if not TitleText.Parent then break end

        TitleText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 255)
        TitleText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
        TitleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 255)

        task.wait(0.3)
    end
end)
